title: Land the CLI per-command catalog priming draft of 2026-10-29
goal: Two workflow subagent worktrees from the 2026-10-29 session 'Composing CLI commands without per-command catalog priming' held uncommitted work that never landed. This one: the CLI wires substrate priming per command — defs::command_catalogs names the catalogs (leading MCP, coding models, execution agents, frameworks) each command needs and PlanePrep::Ecosystem carries that set, so a command primes only what it uses; lifecycle and status commands skip it. Rebased by three-way apply onto main of 2026-10-31 (one conflict: main's Ledger special case is subsumed by mcp_catalogs mapping Ledger to no catalogs). ARCHITECTURE.md describes the per-command priming.
